visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair wearing a black long-sleeved shirt is seated on a soft white sofa within a brightly lit indoor studio or living room setting. He holds a white rectangular product box with both hands, presenting it toward the camera while maintaining a cheerful and engaging facial expression. (2) A close-up shot transitions to show a vibrant purple knitted fabric sleeve with distinct vertical ridges and a small purple woven label attached to the top edge. The man's hands hold the object against a clean, white background to emphasize its texture and craftsmanship. (3) The scene cuts back to the man on the couch as he gestures toward the white box, pointing at the handle area. Multiple yellow text overlays with black outlines appear at the bottom of the screen, providing pricing information for the long and short versions of the product. (4) A detailed close-up focuses on the purple knitted sleeve being held and slightly stretched by the man's hands. The visual highlights the elastic 3D knitting technology and the specific texture of the fabric as the light hits the ridges and valleys of the material. (5) The purple sleeve is shown hanging vertically in front of a neutral background, and animated white sparkle graphics are added around the product to signify its premium quality and design appeal. (6) The man holds an orange iPhone in his left hand and the purple sleeve in his right hand, demonstrating their size comparison. He then places the phone inside the sleeve to show how it fits snugly within the knitted accessory. (7) The video transitions to show the purple sleeve tied elegantly to the strap of a black leather handbag. The man stands up and walks away from the camera, wearing the bag across his shoulder to demonstrate how the sleeve functions as a stylish fashion accessory. (8) Returning to the seated position on the couch, the man continues to speak while holding and manipulating the purple sleeve, eventually placing his phone back inside the accessory as the video concludes.

(2) A quick cut SFX marks a transition in the visual, but the vocal delivery remains continuous, maintaining a moderate-fast speed with clear articulation of the opening hook. (3) A distinctive 'pop' sound effect occurs, emphasizing the introduction of the purple knitted product. The speaker's pitch rises slightly to convey enthusiasm for the item. (4) A bright 'ding' bell SFX is heard as the speaker mentions the pricing details, serving as an acoustic highlighter for the informative text appearing on screen. (5) A humorous slurping or gulping sound effect is used as a creative transition between the product introduction and the detailed texture analysis. (6) A series of high-pitched, twinkling sparkle SFX are layered over the speech as the 3D knitting technology is mentioned, reinforcing the 'magical' or high-quality feel of the product. (7) Another sharp cut SFX punctuates the list of compatible iPhone models, while the BGM maintains its consistent 124 BPM drive underneath the narration. (8) A success-style melodic chime SFX plays when the speaker demonstrates the accessory attached to a luxury bag, signaling a positive outcome or a clever fashion tip. (9) A final snap SFX and a descending melodic stinger conclude the video, with the BGM and voice both cutting out precisely at the end of the frame.
